title: cleistocalyx nervosus
intro: Cleistocalyx nervosus, commonly known as the nervosa tree or nervosa, is a species of tree in the family Rutaceae. The nervosa tree has been traditionally used in folk medicine, particularly in Southeast Asia, due to its numerous health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Cleistocalyx nervosus include its ability to treat fever, headache, and respiratory issues, as well as its use as an antidote for various poisonings. The bioactive constituents of the nervosa tree include essential oils, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
